learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to identify the basic principles of environmental engineering.
Students will be able to recognize the fundamentals of environmental impact assessment and environmental management systems.
Students will be able to differentiate the scientific and technical foundations of waste treatment systems.
Students will be able to perform calculations on waste treatment systems.
Students will be able to differentiate the scientific and technical foundations of wastewater treatment systems.
Students will be able to perform calculations on wastewater treatment systems.
Students will be able to differentiate the scientific and technical foundations of atmospheric emission control and treatment systems.
Students will be able to perform calculations on atmospheric emission control and treatment systems.

assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum grade of 5.0 must be obtained independently in both the theory and problem parts. If either the theory or problem part is not passed, the grade for the approved part can be kept until the October examination session. Continuous assessment options are available for both theory and problems, allowing partial exams to count towards the final grade under specific conditions. An additional 0.2 points are awarded for field trip attendance if all other parts are passed.
